desc:
Kirk Sorensen's Tech Talk, delivered at Google on July 20, 2009.

Successfully developing a liquid-fluoride thorium reactor (LFTR) would essentially solve our planets energy problems for thousands of years, because it would allow us to fully utilize the energy in natural thorium, which makes up 0.0012% of the Earths crust.
